query: Please implement a management system for managing and configuring various data and permissions. The system should have a responsive layout, supporting access from various devices. The system should have robust data management capabilities, including data source configuration, button and data permission control, and customizable departmental data permissions. The system should have comprehensive security measures, including XSS prevention and script filtering. The system should support internationalization and logging. Choose light salmon for the background; set all component colors to tomato.
